research_summary: The Netherlands has a mature and highly competitive invoicing & billing software market with strong emphasis on Dutch tax compliance (BTW/VAT) and e-invoicing standards (Peppol). 70%+ SME penetration with cloud-based solutions accounting for 67% market share.
market_observations: All major platforms support mandatory BTW calculation, MT940 banking, Peppol e-invoicing (mandatory B2G since 2017). Pricing ranges €10-99/month subscription or €0.65/document. Cloud adoption at 67%. Strong preference for Dutch providers.
